rti-process-officer.title: RTI Process & Officer
rti-process-officer.subtitle: Public Information Officer (PIO), First Appellate Authority, and application procedures under Right to Information Act 2005.

sections.heading: Right to Information (RTI) Compliance
paragraphs: In accordance with the provisions of the **Right to Information Act, 2005**, The New Horizons Institute of Technology maintains proactive disclosure of its academic regulations, approvals, fee structures, and administrative framework to ensure accountability and public transparency.
Any citizen of India seeking specific institutional information may file a written application addressed to the Public Information Officer (PIO) accompanied by the prescribed statutory fee.

sections.heading: Procedure for Submitting an RTI Application
items: **Application Format:** Draft an application in English or Bengali stating clearly the specific information sought, along with the applicant's full name, contact address, and phone number.

**Application Fee:** Enclose a non-refundable application fee of ₹10/- (Rupees Ten only) via Demand Draft, Indian Postal Order (IPO), or cash receipt from the institute accounts counter, payable to "The New Horizons Institute of Technology".
**Postal Delivery:** Send via Registered/Speed Post or deliver in person to the Public Information Officer, NHIT Campus, Phase-II, City Center, Durgapur — 713208.
**Time Limit for Response:** The PIO will furnish information or reply within **30 days** from the date of receipt, as mandated under Section 7(1) of the RTI Act 2005.

anti-ragging-committee.title: Anti-Ragging Committee & Squad
anti-ragging-committee.subtitle: Uncompromising safety, proactive mentorship, and strict compliance with Hon'ble Supreme Court directives and AICTE Anti-Ragging Regulations.

sections.heading: Zero-Tolerance Anti-Ragging Policy
paragraphs: **Ragging in any form is strictly banned inside the campus, classrooms, laboratories, hostels, buses, and off-campus surroundings.**

As per the directions of the **Hon'ble Supreme Court of India** and the regulations framed by **AICTE (Notification F.No. 37-3/Legal/AICTE/2009)**, any student found indulging in physical, verbal, mental, or cyber ragging will face immediate suspension, permanent expulsion, cancellation of admission, and FIR lodging with civil law enforcement.

quality-policy-iso-certification.title: Quality Policy & ISO Certification
quality-policy-iso-certification.subtitle: Our institutional commitment to high standards in engineering instruction, governance, laboratory maintenance, and continuous quality enhancement.

sections.heading: Institutional Quality Policy Statement
paragraphs: “The New Horizons Institute of Technology is dedicated to providing state-of-the-art technical and polytechnic education through rigorous curriculum delivery, intensive workshop practice, and continuous professional grooming.”

“We commit to complying with all statutory requirements of AICTE and WBSCT&VE&SD, continually enhancing the effectiveness of our Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 9001:2015 international standards, and nurturing ethically grounded, industry-competent engineers.”
